# T-2: Add runtime log writer

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add human-readable runtime log capture for flow run commands with explicit and default log-file paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- --log-file writes a human-readable log to the requested execution-root-relative path.
- Omitted --log-file writes to <agentWorkDir>/logs/<flowId>/ or <agentWorkDir>/logs/no-flow/.
- stdout still contains only the command's final JSON envelope.

## Implementation Notes
Integrate at dispatcher boundaries so writeErr, pre/post warnings, and command lifecycle diagnostics can be copied without changing Command outputMode contracts.

## Test Strategy
Dispatcher/unit tests with captured stdout/stderr and filesystem assertions for explicit/default log files.
